rules.headline: A design is measured by the kit's own detector (tools/design/detector, 59 rules, no network, no telemetry), never by eye alone and never by running impeccable's engine

rules.headline: Design directions come from the local catalog; impeccable.style's roll is asked only opted out (X-Impeccable-Telemetry: off, random key, no project data) and never pings a choice unless station.json impeccable_roll.telemetry is true
A design handoff has one format and design tokens one schema and one flattening rule (tools/design/handoff.py); no station keeps its own copy
